messages.content: now that i have finished lunch, i want to read for a while.
you could find a quiet place and sit with your book.
i will read in the garden if it is warm.
then the garden is your plan if it is warm enough for you.
what if i want to stay inside instead?
you can choose a quiet place inside. the place can change while you still keep reading in the plan.
this book has been read by both my children.
did they both enjoy it?
one said the story was good, but the other did not enjoy it.
they can read the same book and not both enjoy it.
does that mean one of them read the wrong book?
no. one child can enjoy a story even if the other does not.
i cannot come today because i have work to finish. ask about tomorrow instead.
i have work to finish today. could i come tomorrow instead?
do not say i will be free for sure.
i have work to finish today. could i come tomorrow instead?
what did you keep from my reason?
you have work to finish today.
my sister would like soup, and i would like rice instead.
if you have both, you can each have the food you want.
we do. can we still sit together?
yes. you do not have to eat the same food to sit together.
what does my sister want?
soup.
i have cleaned the table, but i am still washing the cups.
the table is done, and the cups are still being washed.
does that say i have finished all of it?
no. the cup washing is still happening.
write a short sentence about that.
i have cleaned the table and am still washing the cups.
would you help me ask my brother not to take my pencil?
please do not take my pencil.
can it be a question instead?
could you please leave my pencil here?
i do not want to say he already took it.
the question does not say that he took it. it asks him to leave it here.
i was going to go out, but i was tired after work.
did you stay home instead?
yes. i made tea and read.
you changed your plan and had a quiet time at home.
what was my first plan?
go out.
while i was walking home, i met my cousin. where was i going?
home.
was i already home?
no. you were walking home when you met your cousin.
just say who i met.
your cousin.
write that i read a little every morning.
i read a little every morning.
now make it about my father.
my father reads a little every morning.
which word did you use instead of read?
reads.
my mother said she will visit after lunch. write her words to me.
i will visit after lunch.
is that a note from you?
no. it is a note in the voice of your mother, as you asked.
now just say who will visit.
your mother.
i like books that have a happy end. write that in one sentence.
i like books that have a happy end.
does it say i like every book?
no. it says what kind of book you like.
now change happy to quiet.
i like books that have a quiet end.
help me say the order: put the book away, then get my coat.
first put the book away, then get your coat.
if i have already put the book away, what is left?
get your coat.
do i need to start again?
no. the book part is already done.
ask my friend to call me if she can.
could you please call me if you can?
does that sound like she has to call?
it asks in a kind way and keeps if you can in the question.
now make it about visiting me.
could you please visit me if you can?
i have lost my place in the book, but i still have the book.
what do you remember from the part you last read?
a boy was waiting at the station with his father.
you could look for that part of the story to find your place again.
do you need to help me find the book?
no. you said you still have the book. you need to find your place in it.
after my sister comes home, we will make lunch together.
lunch is your plan for after she comes home.
has she come home already from what i said?
you did not say that. you said what you will do after she comes.
what will we do together?
make lunch.
ask my brother how many books he has.
how many books do you have?
now ask how many he had yesterday.
how many books did you have yesterday?
does that ask where the books are?
no. it asks for the number.
my aunt gave my mother a cup. who gave it?
your aunt.
who got it?
your mother.
now write it with my mother first.
my mother got a cup from my aunt.
if i feel tired after work, i will not go for a walk.
your plan is to stay in if you feel tired after work.
what if i do not feel tired?
your sentence does not say what you will choose then.
can you just keep the first plan?
if i feel tired after work, i will not go for a walk.
i wrote the note and put it in my bag.
you finished the note, and it is ready in your bag.
i will give it to my teacher tomorrow.
you can take it with you tomorrow and give it to your teacher.
did i already give it to her?
no. you said that is for tomorrow.
write that the room is small but i like it.
the room is small, but i like it.
does small mean i hate it?
no. the room is small, but you still like it.
keep it very simple.
the room is small, but i like it.
ask my sister if she has washed the cups.
have you washed the cups?
now ask if she is washing them now.
are you washing the cups now?
which question asks about work already done?
have you washed the cups?
answer did you see my bag with no and a sentence.
no, i did not see your bag.
now make it yes instead.
yes, i saw your bag.
are you saying you really saw it?
no. i am writing the example answers you asked for.
i like sitting by the window because i can see the garden.
you enjoy seeing the garden from there.
can you say it with my own words?
i like sitting by the window because i can see the garden.
what is the reason i gave?
you can see the garden.
my brother and i went to the park. write it with we.
we went to the park.
now make it a question.
did we go to the park?
does the question ask what we will do later?
no. it asks about what you already did.
a girl in a green coat with a little bag is waiting by the school. who is waiting? keep it short.
a girl.
where is she?
by the school.
what color is her coat?
green.
i am still reading the last page.
you are on the last page, but you have not said you finished it.
i just finished it now.
now you have finished the last page.
what changed?
you went from still reading it to having finished it.
write that i must go home before dinner.
i must go home before dinner.
now make it about my sister.
my sister must go home before dinner.
did you keep before?
yes.
i got home, took my coat off, and put my bag away. what came last?
you put your bag away.
what came before taking my coat off?
getting home.
just the order again.
get home, take your coat off, put your bag away.
can we talk about books instead of work?
yes. what kind of book do you enjoy?
i like to read a quiet story about a family.
do you have a story like that you would like to talk about?
not now. i just want to say what i like.
okay. you like a quiet story about a family.
i am going to read now. thanks for talking.
you are welcome. enjoy your reading.
no more help for now.
okay. goodbye for now.
